content:
leah: quick alert from nightly: distro base image shows glibc advisory that affects our slim runtime. proposing a focused rebuild and signed rollout tonight.
dan: thanks. scope? which repos/pools use that base tag?
leah: runtime-base:2025-04 (used by runtime-prod/* and runtime-canary/*). lot of services pinned, so we should keep changes minimal.
priya: checklist suggestion: 1) minimal package upgrade (glibc) 2) regenerate SBOM 3) sign image with KMS-backed key 4) push to registry w/ exp-backoff tag 5) canary deploy to isolated pool 6) validate telemetry + vuln scan
kevin: RBAC items: build-runner-sa needs roles/cloudkms.signer and registry.writer. also ensure image-promoter-sa can read signed metadata bucket.
leah: note on verification: we plan to publish cosign public key to signed-keys bucket and let runtime image pullers verify locally. runtime nodes should not have KMS sign perms.
ci-bot: build triggered: rebase-glibc-3849 (artifact tag: runtime-base:2025-04-rebase-3849)
priya: cosign example (AWS KMS path shown as reference):
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-... runtime-base:2025-04-rebase-3849
```
kevin: small twist: if we use cross-project KMS, add IAM binding for build-runner-sa in the key project with kms:AsymmetricSign. otherwise cosign fails with PERMISSION_DENIED.
leah: can we avoid long-lived creds for the signing step? prefer ephemeral signer task with workload identity / OIDC token.
dan: yes — ephemeral signed container is scheduled and uses short-lived token. build pipeline only pushes unsigned tarball to staging storage. signing job pulls it, signs via KMS, pushes signed manifest.
priya: audit / SIEM needs: capture Key.AsymmetricSign, storage.objects.create, containeranalysis occurrences. retention: 90d for key events, 365d for registry pushes.
kms-bot: key policy notes: enforce key rotation every 60d, disable import, create CryptoKeyVersion labels with build-run id. Log sink to security-logs project configured.
kevin: another RBAC caveat: registry's vulnerability scan bot needs containeranalysis.notes.create permission to annotate scan results. make sure scanner-sa has that in registry project.
leah: canary plan: create node pool label rebase-canary=true (size 2), route 2% traffic, run smoke + auth + latency tests. monitor: p50/p95, memory RSS, OOM, error rates. auto-rollback on >1% error delta or memory growth >25%.
dan: add gating: block promotion if any medium/high findings in post-deploy vuln-scan. automation should fail roll forward.
priya: SBOM: attach CycloneDX to image manifest. add quick grep check in smoke job to ensure glibc version present.
kevin: incident-response note: if we discover signing key compromise, steps: 1) revoke current key version 2) mark signed images as untrusted via rollout policy 3) sign replacement images with new key and rotate on runtime verify config to fetch new pubkey. create incident channel and page infra + security.
leah: follow-up tasks: kevin open IAM PR for build-runner-sa + scanner-sa, dan wire ephemeral signer job, priya add SBOM step + vuln gate, oncall-ops reserve 20:00-22:00 PT for rollout.
oncall-ops: confirmed 20:00-22:00 PT. if page fires, escalate to sec-oncall.
ci-bot: signing job completed, cosign output: "signature: ok". artifact pushed to registry with tag runtime-base:2025-04-rebase-3849-signed
priya: running quick vuln-scan on canary pool now. will post summary in 10m.
d an: I'll attach PR links shortly: https://git.internal/infra/PR-4521 and https://git.internal/build/PR-8899
kevin: I added a storage bucket IAM grant for runtime-puller-sa to get public key: gs://signed-keys/runtime-base/3849.pub
leah: thanks team. if vuln-scan is green we follow the promote schedule: 2% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%, 30m between steps, with auto-rescan.
priya: interim vuln-scan: no medium/high findings, a couple low backports tolerated. proceeding with 2% canary.
leah: closing loop: update runbook with these exact commands and IAM bits, add playbook section for cosign-revoke and key-rotation steps.
kevin: noted. will also add a short blameless note in post-deploy. :white_check_mark:
leah: excellent. keep this thread for any blockers during the window.
